title: DevBox history entry
description: One line of ~/.local/state/devbox/history/<YYYY-MM>.jsonl, written by the core once per finished session.

$schema.description: URL of this JSON Schema, for editor completion.

id.description: Session ID: "s_" followed by 10 to 26 upper-case Crockford base32 characters.

action.description: Fully qualified action that ran, e.g. java.update. For group runs still the single action of this session.

plugin.description: ID of the plugin that owns the action.

group.description: ID of the group, when the session was started as part of a group run.

title.description: Human-readable session title in the language active at start.

user.description: System account that started the session.

origin.description: Where the session was started: web UI, CLI, terminal menu, plain API client, first-time setup, group run or event handler.

dryRun.description: True when the session ran with DEVBOX_DRY_RUN=1.

state.description: Final session state, derived from the exit code or from cancellation and timeout.

exitCode.description: Exit code of the action process; null when the process was killed without one.

changes.description: Number of change messages reported (planned changes in a dry run).

summary.description: Summary from the result message, or empty when the action sent none.
